parties.respondent: The Deputy Commissioner of Commercial Taxes(SPL) & Anr.

summary: Warranty replacement parts sales tax liability; credit notes as consideration; principal-to-principal vs principal-agent relationship; distinguishability from Mohd. Ekram Khan; warranty obligation discharge free of cost; issue reference on whether credit notes exigible to sales tax; multiple High Court judgments consolidated.
legal_provisions_cited: Rajasthan Sales Tax Act, 1994 s.2(38), s.28, s.30, s.65, s.86
final_judgment: Reference to larger Bench made; leave granted; High Court judgments distinguished based on contractual relationships and warranty terms.
